people.name: Arabia
people.line: A region and its inhabitants, mentioned in various contexts.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
translations.bsb: not including the revenue from the merchants and traders. And all the Arabian kings and governors of the land also brought gold and silver to Solomon.
translations.kjv: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
translations.asv: besides that which the traders and merchants brought: and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
